<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/cases/{caseId}/classify"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>

Send inline rows (at most 1,000 rows or 10 MB), rows.source upload (then upload the file to the returned uploadUrl and call commit), or record keys of the knowledge base (at most 10,000). The tree, memo and records table versions are pinned when the job starts.
